title: Termite image dataset and MobileNetV2-CAB-TL2 training code for fine-grained termite identification

creators.name: Huang, Hao
creators.affiliation: College of Mathematics and Computer Science, Zhejiang A&F University

creators.name: Wang, Hangjun
creators.affiliation: School of Electronic Information Engineering, Huzhou College

description:
Code, trained weights and image dataset supporting a lightweight deep learning model (MobileNetV2-CAB-TL2) for fine-grained identification of eight termite species–caste categories (workers and soldiers of Coptotermes formosanus, Reticulitermes chinensis, Odontotermes formosanus and Macrotermes barneyi).

The dataset comprises 4,000 images (500 per category) collected in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China, June–November 2025. The reproduction-resolution package (256 × 256 px) ships with the GitHub release; the full-resolution master copy (4096 × 3072 px) is archived as a separate version of this record. Code is released under MIT, data under CC BY 4.0.
